G4282: προ-ετοιμάζω, [in LXX: Isaiah 28:24 B, Wi 9:8*;] to prepare before: c. acc. rei, Romans 9:23 (οἷς for ἅ by attraction), Ephesians 2:10.†
G4283: *† προ-ευαγγελίζομαι, to announce glad tidings beforehand: Galatians 3:8.†
G4284:
προ-έχω, [in LXX: Job 27:6 A (חזק hi.)*;]
